name: 83442 · Rigby, ID
findings: ZIP 83442 (Rigby) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83442 (Rigby) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83442 (Rigby) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 24% of the typical level).
